answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 13086 Country: India Title: ASLM'K I WANNA TO KNOW FROM U THAT IS, USE OF HOMEOPATHY MEDECINES IS JAIZ OR NAJAIZ IN ISLAM.BECAUSE THIS TYPE OF MEDECINE USED SOME ALCHOL. Question: ASLM'K I WANNA TO KNOW FROM U THAT IS, USE OF HOMEOPATHY MEDECINES IS JAIZ OR NAJAIZ IN ISLAM.BECAUSE THIS TYPE OF MEDECINE USED SOME ALCHOL. Answer ID: 13086 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1001/850=D/1430) The alcohol made in India and elsewhere is generally made of potato, wheat etc; therefore such alcohols can be used particularly in medicines when needed. But the alcohols made of grapes, dates, raisin must be avoided; since even a drop of such alcohol is impure and unlawful to use. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
